describe: Operating on a graph of entities and relations — a knowledge graph is the standing example. Nodes and edges are both elements, addressed by id; removing an entity takes its relations with it unless a stricter binding is supplied.
name: Graph surgery

vocabulary.describe: Insert a node with no position (a graph node has none)
vocabulary.name: add-entity

vocabulary.describe: Insert an edge, its position a { from, to } pair of present nodes
vocabulary.name: add-relation

vocabulary.describe: Remove a node; its incident edges go with it (fallout: detach)
vocabulary.name: remove-entity

vocabulary.describe: Remove an edge; its nodes stand
vocabulary.name: remove-relation

vocabulary.describe: Swap a node or edge's content under the same id — wiring unchanged
vocabulary.name: replace-property

vocabulary.describe: Move an edge to a new { from, to }; a node itself cannot be moved
vocabulary.name: rewire-relation

vocabulary.describe: The edit script that turns one graph into another, by element identity
vocabulary.name: compare-graphs

vocabulary.describe: Union two graphs by identity, under this set's bindings
vocabulary.name: merge-graphs
